# App testing status

<!-- Generated by ci/gen-app-docs.py from the catalog and the Playwright suites.
     Do not edit by hand: run `./ci/gen-app-docs.py` (ci/static.sh checks it). -->

Every catalogued app carries two independent statements:

* **Auto-tested** - each check the entry declares is carried by a test that runs
  in the gate, so a regression fails CI without a human. *Auto-checked* means a
  test exists but it is informational (excluded from the gate).
* **Human** - the last time a person actually used the app, and on which chart
  version. When the chart has moved since, it is shown as **stale**: the check
  happened, but not on the version you are installing.

Both are derived from evidence, not typed in. A check name must appear as an
`@check:<name>` tag on a real test, which `umkim-thin catalog verify --strict`
resolves; an entry that names a check nothing carries fails the static gate.

### ai

- `route_reachable` - apps.spec.ts
- `auth_challenge` - apps.spec.ts
- `authenticated_request_reaches_app` - apps.spec.ts
- `oidc_sso_completes` - auth.spec.ts
- `llm_models_listed` - ai.spec.ts
- `llm_completion_answers` - ai.spec.ts
- `llm_user_api_key_lifecycle` - ai.spec.ts
- `llm_api_key_bearer_client` - ai.spec.ts
- `llm_cpu_mode_requests_no_gpu` - ci/ai-check.sh
- `llm_backends_are_separate` - ci/ai-check.sh
- `tenant_api_ai` - ai.spec.ts

Human pass 2026-11-21 by agent on chart 0.1.9 (single):

- the earlier 0.1.7 pass on dev-single and ha-dev still holds: install, OIDC tenant sign-in, CPU mode requesting no GPU, and a non-admin minting and revoking their own key
- 0.1.9 on the GPU host (Pascal GTX 1050 Ti, 4 GiB): sampling defaults and the layer count reach the pod spec - --temp 0.2, --top-p 0.9, --top-k 20, --min-p 0.05, --n-gpu-layers 24 all verified in the running Deployment
- the server defaults actually apply and can still be overridden per request: six unseeded completions at the configured temp 0.2 gave 4 distinct answers, while the same six with temperature 1.9, top_p 1.0 and top_k 0 sent in the request gave 6 distinct
- a non-admin minted a key in a browser and used it from curl with only the bearer token - GET /api/v1/models returned the model list and a chat completion answered - then revoked it and the same key got 401
- found and fixed the reason that key could not work before: Authelia's forward-auth intercepted /api/v1/* and returned a 302 to the portal, so the token never reached Open WebUI. The catalog entry now exempts the bearer endpoints by exact path
- switched the model set through the console API (1.5B added alongside 0.5B, context 4096, parallel 1): both GGUFs landed on the volume, the gateway published both friendly names, and both answered through the gateway
- confirmed the memory warning is calibrated rather than decorative: 0.5B q4 at 2048 context reported 'about 28 MiB of cache' and the engine measured 491 MiB resident on the card

Human pass 2026-11-20 by agent on chart 0.1.4 (single, ha):

- installed from the console on dev-single and ha-dev; the post-install job created the admin and set the registration role, and the app came up with 0 restarts
- signed in at the portal as a freshly invited tenant and completed the OIDC round trip; BookStack auto-registered the account
- as that tenant, created a book through the app and saw it listed in the books index
- minted an API token as a signed-in user, then created a book and a page through /api and read the page body back
- confirmed the ha-dev bootstrap needs its own storage tree: the image's s6 init does not run for a Job, so Laravel could not open storage/logs
